| container | format | reader | notes |

| `Substance CHD v5 / ISO (DVD-9, 3,142,944 sectors)` | two ISO9660 volumes: layer 0 = 1,167,824 sectors (SYSTEM.CNF, ELF, MODULES, SKATE, MGS2/STAGE2.DAT, DEMO2/VOX2/MOVIEVR); layer 1 from sector 1,167,808, PVD at the layer break 1,167,824 (MGS2/STAGE.DAT, DEMO, VOX, MOVIE, FACE, CODEC) | gbox/mgs2_inventory.py (Disc reads both layers; gbox.chd.ChdDisc walks layer 0 only) | ELF opens them as cdrom0:/MGS2/%s;1, file table at 0x180b08 |
| `MGS2/STAGE.DAT (Tanker+Plant, 129 stages) and MGS2/STAGE2.DAT (VR/alt missions, 165 stages)` | sector 0 = clear u32 key + encrypted TOC {char name[8], u32 sector}; word cipher x^=k, k=k*0x02e90edd+step | gbox/mgs2_inventory.py StageArchive | verified: every page of both archives inflates |
| `stage` | encrypted header u32 n + rows {type<<24 \| 24-bit name hash, offset}; 0x7f row = page id + size, 0x7e row = compressed size + offset; page data = zlib 1.1.3 stream encrypted with the same cipher (seed from first u16) | gbox/mgs2_inventory.py | file types: 0x01 stage program overlay (loaded 0x1F6500), 0x0A kms model, 0x13 texture pack, 0x02 hull, 0x0C/0x12 motion, 0x07 geometry, 0x0B script |
| `kms model / texture pack` | kms: 0x40 header, 0x40-byte bones, 0x30-byte parts of <=32 verts (one tristrip each, s16 mm, weight in 1/4096); texture pack: GS VRAM uploaded page-linear PSMCT32, 0xa0-byte records with TEX0/CLAMP A+D packet | gbox/mgs2_models.py, gbox/ps2_gs.py (PSMCT32/PSMT8/PSMT4 swizzles) | 19 roster models identified by rendering every human-like kms |
| `Sons of Liberty ISO (single layer, 2,256,304 sectors)` | same STAGE.DAT format, key 0x3BB323D9, 115 stages; DEMO/MOVIE/STAGE/CODEC/FACE/VOX tile the image | gbox/mgs2_sol.py | probe only |

## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** characters op=use/live_use builds the ISO then @launch through the server's session_swap (save state, modded image on the same worker, load state); the old models stay in RAM until the next stage load (door, elevator, cutscene, Continue). Never run in game.

**Pick whip: partial.** whip 'Try live replacement' -> characters op=live_use target=<name> -> mgs2_swap.use: name -> slot (Snake/Raiden/Olga..., 'soldier'/'heavy' -> that area's soldier slot, player -> Snake on Tanker else Raiden), stage from 0x1B9300; build + session_swap. /api/whip/identify adds slot. Untested.

**Live controls:** none MGS2-specific; generic read_memory/write_memory only. The in-RAM kms hot-patch (replace a loaded kms without a stage load) is not built.

### RAM / runtime hooks (curated)

| hook | address | what | status | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| platform RAM access (PCSX2) | `EE RAM at offset 0 (native address = offset; MAIN_RAM ps2 0x0..0x2000000)` | RetroArch adapter read/write_memory: READ_CORE_MEMORY, else READ/WRITE_CORE_RAM; writes in 512-byte chunks, read back. Writing EE-recompiled code pages from outside crashes pcsx2_libretro | proven_write | gbox/adapters.py 2189-2225, gbox/gta_games.py, gbox/gta_mods_tool.py |
| stage loader state pointer | `0x1B9300` | +0x3C = name_hash of the current stage (mapped through 283 stage names) - mgs2_swap.current_stage | unverified | gbox/mgs2_swap.py STAGE_STATE_PTR; docs/mgs2.md |
| stage program overlay | `0x1F6500` | page 0 (type 0x01) load address; its strings name the models | unverified | gbox/mgs2_inventory.py PAGE_LOAD |

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- first PCSX2 run of a cast build: drawing, strip parity, atlas TEX0/CLUT, second-texture flags (parts written as 0x48/0x49), stencil shadows, memory
- read 0x1B9300 on a running session to confirm current_stage
- in-RAM kms hot-patch so a swap shows without a stage load
- 6 of 549 model copies keep the original (grow the pack or merge into existing rects)
- hull (0x02) and motion banks are not rewritten; donors use the original hull
- Sons of Liberty (3fc2fad561187055) has no reader/writer beyond the probe
